title: a16z Podcast: On Mentors and Mentees

reader_summary.headline: with Ken Coleman, Ben Horowitz (@bhorowitz).
reader_summary.overview: with Ken Coleman, Ben Horowitz (@bhorowitz), and Michel Feaster (@michelfeaster) Everyone talks about the importance of mentorship in our professional development. But how does one break into an industry without established contacts or prior exposure? Are things different if mentors/mentees come from different backgrounds?

key_points.text: with Ken Coleman, Ben Horowitz (@bhorowitz), and Michel Feaster (@michelfeaster) Everyone talks about the importance of mentorship in our professional development.
If you're already more established in your career, how can you help up-and-comers...
and actually, how could mentees help mentors, too?
